status: fixed before executing this study; internal protocol, not externally preregistered
purpose: Exact conditional decisions in finite declared models, not estimation of population accuracy

event_order.queries: event position of A, B, C, D, one-based

nuisance_query: independent metadata tag, appended after physical queries; excluded from target and recurrent input

gabriel.config: unchanged default Config, input_dim per adapter
gabriel.head: w=U[:,0]-U[:,1], score=w dot final activity, positive score is label 1
gabriel.training: none; diagnostic fixed readout, not a predictive accuracy experiment

cost: one unit per actual scalar or metadata query, zero for inference and skipped constant tests
minimax_ties: query index, independent of test outcomes
greedy_ties: query index; entropy floating tie tolerance 1e-12, EC2 exact rational comparisons
evaluation: exhaustive over each finite catalogue; uniform averages, worst costs, unresolved decisions, remaining physical histories; save every path
additional_checks: all 24576 four-hypothesis three-binary-query tables with balanced binary targets
safe quotient versus all raw aliases
scope: Noise-free immutable observation tables in the main experiment; no market, clinical, hardware, or general domain-transfer performance claim
